Some of the thunderstorms will probably become severe, capable of producing very large, damaging hail and locally damaging winds. Severe weather threat is expected to develop between 2 and 5 pm, peak between 5 and 8 pm, then begin to gradually diminish after 8 pm. A powerful cold front will cause a sharp temperature drop late morning into the afternoon, with temperatures falling by as much as 25°F in one hour. After an active weather day today, dry weather is expected Friday through the weekend. After a chilly day Friday, a gradual warm-up will take place this weekend into early next week.
